source.text:
#wearehiring
We are looking for a new Chef de Partie (M/F/X) starting in November 2026.

We are a Wine Bar & Restaurant located in a beautiful historical pharmacy from 1860 in Kreuzberg.

Our cooking style is seasonal, straightforward, and rooted in European culinary traditions.

If you would like to apply for this FULL TIME position, please let us now who you are and why you would love to be a part of Ora alongside with your CV to: jobs@michelbergerhotel.com

Looking forward to all your applications!
#hiringberlin #gastrojobs #foodberlin

claims.subject: place

reference.notes: A job ad posted by the venue itself, so it is promotional and the place is not visited. The hiring itself is kept as a neutral fact with no aspect. The cooking-style description reads as approving, but it could also be read as a neutral fact.
